messages:
Priya Desai: hi everyone, first week here! i tried to access the staging console to flip a feature flag for my onboarding smoke tests but i'm getting a 403. followed the onboarding guide but maybe missed a step. who can help me get staging console + ff-operator for a few hours?

Samir K.: welcome Priya! :wave: Can you paste the URL or screenshot? likely missing the console-staging group. if you need ff-operator temporarily that's fine but we'll request approval.

Priya Desai: hitting https://console-staging.redwood-inference.com/environments/staging/flags - screenshot shows "403 Forbidden". Need to toggle feature onboarding_mode for a smoke run. I submitted a JIT request but not sure who needs to approve.

Toni Lee: hey Priya 0

Toni Lee: small note: the JIT goes to your manager + infra on-call. Samir (infra) and Eli (security) usually clear quick onboarding flips. I can also attach the smoke test plan to expedite.

Samir K.: requested temporary access for Priya (ff-operator + console-staging-read) — approval pending from Eli. infra-bot created request #22011.

Eli Gomez: approved for 4 hours after seeing the smoke plan. infra-bot: please provision.

infra-bot: Provisioning request queued (#22011). ETA ~3 minutes.

Priya Desai: got the invite and signed in, can now view the feature flags. flipping onboarding_mode=true now.

Toni Lee: great. quick tip: use the rollout page to limit to 5% traffic for testing. also check the quick metrics view.

Priya Desai: smoke passed, rolling back to false. thanks for the quick help everyone! marking solved. :sparkles:
